material_reason: The frozen Wave 01 selection rationale materially relied on the only currently registered reusable V2 DEVELOPMENT market pack. DATA_MANIFEST establishes that the A116 pack bytes are not materialized in V2, while the bounded legacy A116 source is a certification-era context around a legacy champion rather than a neutral Greenfield sampling frame. This is a pre-outcome data-availability/convenience anchor, not economic contamination or economic failure.
reconsideration_rule: Wave 01 may be reconsidered only if prospectively justified independently of legacy-data convenience and the required data bytes/provenance are available.
